en: Shams al-Din Muhammad ibn Abi Talib al-Dimashqi
tr: Şemseddîn Muhammed b. Ebî Tâlib ed-Dımaşkî
ar: شمس الدين محمد بن أبي طالب الدمشقي

description.tr: Coğrafya, doğa tarihi ve atmosfer bilimini birleşik bir çerçevede derleyen kapsamlı kozmografya — ortaçağın son büyük doğa ansiklopedilerinden || Nuhbe'si Batlamyus coğrafyası, Arap gözlemi ve doğa felsefesinin bir sentezidir. || [Tarih notu] Uzun süre ihmal edilen Nuhbe, özgün meteorolojik gözlemleriyle dikkat çekmektedir.
description.en: Compiled a comprehensive cosmography integrating geography, natural history, and atmospheric science into a unified framework — one of the last great medieval encyclopedias of nature || His Nukhba is a synthesis of Ptolemaic geography, Arabic observation, and natural philosophy. It preserves data from lost works and adds original observations on Syrian geology and weather. || [Historiographical note] Long neglected, the Nukhba has gained attention for its original meteorological observations and geological descriptions of the Levant.
description.ar: جمع موسوعة كونية شاملة تدمج الجغرافيا والتاريخ الطبيعي وعلم الغلاف الجوي || نخبته تجمع بين الجغرافيا البطلمية والملاحظات العربية والفلسفة الطبيعية
